prompt: Design an implementation-ready mockup of the TripLOG “여행 경비” overview card, showing a 354px-wide mobile card and a 448px-wide desktop card side by side. Follow the existing TripLOG design system: white surfaces, dark navy text and thin outlines, rounded corners, and restrained yellow, sky-blue, pink, mint and lavender accents. Prioritize the accumulated total “486,000원”, with “지출 기록 보기” as the navigation action, “기록한 지출 14건”, and “1인 평균 243,000원”. Visualize recorded spending composition with a compact proportional segmented bar and readable category labels, amounts and shares: 숙소 180,000원 37%, 식비 126,000원 26%, 교통 90,000원 19%, 관광 54,000원 11%, 기타 36,000원 7%. Make the hierarchy, spacing and colors cohesive with a Korean travel planner, compact and readable on mobile. These are actual accumulated expenses; include no planned budget, spending limit, remaining allowance or budget progress indicator. Render the complete cards with practical HTML/CSS structure.
